idea-plugin.name: Deep Project Search
idea-plugin.description:
Deep Project Search

Deep Project Search adds a dedicated JetBrains IDE tool window for searching current project files, project text content, Java library roots, dependency jar entries, dependency text resources, and frontend package directories in one place.

Smart Search keeps the UI small while supporting phrases, wildcards, regex queries, and lightweight scope prefixes from the same keyword field.

It is designed for cases where Search Everywhere may miss files inside dependency jars, package directories, or generated dependency resources until they have been opened once.

How to use

  • Open the Deep Search tool window.
  • Enter a keyword such as UserService, spring.factories, or META-INF services.
  • Choose All, Project Files, or Dependencies.
  • Click Search, or press Enter from the keyword field.
  • Double-click a result, or press Enter on the selected result, to open the project file, package file, jar resource, or class file.
  • Use recent searches from the keyword dropdown to rerun previous queries.
  • Use quick actions to open results, copy paths, or clear the result list.

Smart Search examples

  • password for normal keyword search.
  • "spring boot" for phrase search.
  • *.properties for wildcard file name/path search.
  • /BeanFactory.*/ for regex search.
  • project: password to search only project files.
  • dep: spring.factories to search only dependencies.

Features

  • Searches current project files.
  • Searches project text file contents.
  • Searches Java dependency class and source roots, including jar entries.
  • Searches frontend dependency directories such as node_modules.
  • Searches dependency text resources and source content where available.
  • Supports filename, path, and text content keyword matching.
  • Supports Smart Search phrases, wildcards, regex queries, and lightweight scope prefixes.
  • Shows a preview line for project and dependency content matches.
  • Opens text content matches directly at the matched line and column when possible.
  • Keeps recent search history.
  • Provides quick actions for opening results, copying paths, and clearing results.
  • Provides scope selection without taking over the double-Shift shortcut.
  • Runs searches in a background task.

中文说明

Deep Project Search 是一个独立的 JetBrains IDE 搜索工具窗口，用来统一搜索当前项目文件、Java 依赖 jar 内部的 class/resource 文件，以及前端项目中的 node_modules 依赖文件。 它也支持搜索项目和依赖中的文本内容，不会占用 IDE 双击 Shift 的快捷键。

适合搜索依赖包里的 .class、META-INF、.properties、 .xml、.yml 等文件，也适合在 WebStorm 等前端项目中搜索 node_modules 下的包文件，同时可以搜索当前项目文件和文本内容。 文本内容命中会显示预览，并在可行时直接跳转到命中行。输入框会保留最近搜索记录， 结果列表支持打开、复制路径和清空等快捷操作。

Smart Search 支持 "spring boot" 短语、*.properties 通配符、 /BeanFactory.*/ 正则，以及 project: / dep: 轻量范围前缀， 不需要增加额外按钮或高级面板。
